title: Nutty Fragrant Middle-eastern Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Middle-eastern rice pilaf featuring English mustard, perfect for special occasions and festive gatherings.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: such as canola or grapeseed oil

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a ttukbaegi or a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin, thyme, mustard powder, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rice and stir to coat the rice with the spice mixture, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and stir to combine.
Transfer the rice mixture to a ttukbaegi or a heavy-bottomed saucepan with a tight-fitting lid.
Add 2 1/4 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is fluffy.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the chopped walnuts and pine nuts.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and garnish with additional chopped nuts, if desired.
